messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

message.content:
The kitchen smelled of burnt toast and lavender incense, which meant Lily had been "experimenting" again.

  She stood on a step-stool at the counter, a spoon in one hand, a thin copper wand the length of her pinky in the other, tapping it against the rim of a mug as if it were a metronome.

    Her school blazer was still on, sleeves rolled up, one button missing.

      She turned at the sound of the back door, and her grin was the kind that meant trouble.

        "Rai! *Rai.* Put the bags down, you're on duty."

          She hopped off the stool, wand still tapping, and fell into step beside him.

            "So. Mummy said I need twelve hours of supervised childcare before I can sit Ellie on Thursdays."

              She waved the wand at his chest like she was checking a label on a shirt.

                "Twelve hours. *Twelve.* And do you know who's going to be my test subject?"

                  She didn't wait for an answer.

                    "You are. For the evening. I'm doing a *revert-three*, you'll be six, I'll be the big sister, I'll make you a plate of cut-up ham and a juice box, I'll tuck you in at eight, and at nine I'll pop you back and we'll both go to bed like normal people."

                      She said it the way someone describes the weather.

                        A small, iridescent scar floated above the tip of her wand, pulsing gently, like a firefly trapped in glass.

                          "It's a *very* standard charm. Nana did it to me when I was four and you were the one who had to walk me to the door to get the *real* me back. You remember."

                            She tilted her head, all challenge, spoon still dripping jam.

                              "So? You in, big bro, or do I have to ask Mummy to *make* you in?"

                                The toast popped and burnt in the background.

                                  She waited, wand raised, grin holding, utterly certain of the answer.
